item.title: It Looks Like GET OUT Director Jordan Peele Could Be In Line To Direct An Upcoming Marvel Studios Movie
item.description: Following rumours that Marvel Studios is eager to bring Nope director Jordan Peele into the fold, the filmmaker's production company has issued an intriguing response.

item.title: GREEN LANTERN: Jeremy Irvine Was "Gutted" To Learn He'd Been Dropped As DCEU's Alan Scott
item.description: Return to Silent Hill star Jeremy Irvine has broken his silence on learning that the plug had been pulled on a Green Lantern TV series, which was set to see him play Alan Scott.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Will See Deadpool Paired Up With [SPOILER] And [SPOILER]
item.description: We're all eager to see Ryan Reynolds' Deadpool cross paths with Thor after Deadpool & Wolverine's big tease, but most of Wade Wilson's screentime will see him paired up with two iconic Variants.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: Runtime For A FIFTH Teaser Trailer Seemingly Revealed By Ratings Board
item.description: We believed that the fourth and final Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer would arrive in theaters next week, but it appears that a fifth sneak peek is now also on the way.

item.title: ANT-MAN AND THE WASP Star [SPOILER] Seemingly Confirms They Will Return For AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: We know that Paul Rudd will return as Scott Lang in Avengers: Doomsday, but it seems he's not the only Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania star set to reprise their MCU role.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer #2 Officially Released; Chris Hemsworth Gets Serious As Thor Next December!
item.description: The second Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer has been released by Marvel Studios, and it makes it clear that Chris Hemsworth's Thor is ditching the comedy for a far more serious outlook.

item.title: 8 Marvel Studios Movies And TV Shows That Need To Be A Priority In The Post-AVENGERS: SECRET WARS MCU
item.description: Avengers: Secret Wars is expected to reboot the MCU, and with Marvel Studios slowing down on its big and small screen releases ahead of that movie's debut, these projects need to be a priority post-2027.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Will Reportedly Be A Lower Budget DC Movie; James Gunn Responds To Wonder Woman Casting Rumors
item.description: A new report suggests that DC Studios cut costs on Supergirl to ensure profitability. James Gunn, meanwhile, has debunked a recent Wonder Woman casting claim for Man of Tomorrow.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Directors Tell Fans To "Fear Doom" As Rumors Swirl About Misdirects In Teaser Trailers
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday directors Joe and Anthony Russo have warned fans to #FearDoom following today's teaser trailer release, but are these sneak peeks actually a misdirect?
